meta.themes: Security, Defense AI, Markets, Regulation, Infrastructure

news.title: OpenAI introduced Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI added Lockdown Mode for high-risk enterprise users and standardized Elevated Risk labels for network-enabled features in ChatGPT and Codex.

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark in research preview
news.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark for real-time coding workflows, emphasizing low-latency iteration and separate preview capacity limits.

news.title: Pentagon pushed top AI labs to expand access on classified networks
news.summary: Reuters reported Pentagon pressure on frontier AI providers to support broader defense deployment across classification levels.

news.title: OpenAI CEO said ChatGPT returned to over 10% monthly growth
news.summary: Reuters, citing CNBC, reported renewed ChatGPT growth and strong momentum in OpenAI coding product usage.

news.title: Anthropic reached $380B valuation after a $30B funding round
news.summary: Reuters reported Anthropic's latest funding jump and accelerated enterprise traction, especially around coding-focused offerings.

news.title: Anthropic said it would absorb grid-related data center costs
news.summary: Anthropic announced measures to prevent AI data center expansion costs from being pushed directly to consumer utility bills.

news.title: Investors saw AI shift from broad tailwind to selective disruption
news.summary: Reuters highlighted growing volatility as AI winners and losers diverged across software and mega-cap technology names.

news.title: AI disruption fears spread from software into multiple US sectors
news.summary: Reuters said the AI scare trade broadened into real estate, insurance, logistics, and financial services stocks.

news.title: Anthropic pledged $20M to support AI-regulation political efforts
news.summary: Reuters reported Anthropic's donation to a US political group backing candidates favoring stronger AI regulation.

news.title: Reuters reported Claude was used in a US military operation
news.summary: A Reuters report citing WSJ said Anthropic's Claude was used via Palantir-linked workflows in a high-profile US operation.

news.title: Strategists framed software selloff as a potential rebound setup
news.summary: Reuters reported JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley seeing selective buying opportunities after AI-led software volatility.

news.title: US brokerages dropped as AI disruption fears widened to financials
news.summary: Reuters covered declines in brokerage shares after AI-enabled tax-planning features raised questions about incumbent moat durability.
